iss.description: Base64URL-encoded Ed25519 public key of the delegator

iat.description: Issued at timestamp (UNIX epoch in seconds)

exp.description: Expiration timestamp (UNIX epoch in seconds, max 60s from iat)

jti.description: Unique nonce / UUID to prevent token replay

lim.description: Declared rate limit in requests per minute

scp.description: Action scope granted to the agent
